title: Gate classifier reads a kb article named *-agents.md as AGENTS.md and makes the gate blocking agents-rule
goal: QUESTION_WORDS['agents-rule'] in _tools/bl_authority.py matches AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md only as a whole file name (alone or after a /), so a gate naming the kb article gitops-for-agents.md on a kb-content item is no agents-rule gate (seen on ST-gxpk74c3 gate g1, 'matched agents.md'), while a gate naming AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or a path ending /AGENTS.md stays agents-rule

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=a.derived_class({'touches':['kb/public/agents/x.md']},{'id':'g1','question':'Link it from kb/public/agents/gitops-for-agents.md?','options':['yes','no']});sys.exit(1 if c=='agents-rule' else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as a
it = {'touches': ['kb/public/agents/x.md']}
c = lambda q: a.derived_class(it, {'id': 'g1', 'question': q, 'options': ['yes', 'no']})
r = [c('Link it from kb/public/agents/gitops-for-agents.md?'), c('Does AGENTS.md carry the new rule?'),
     c('Edit CLAUDE.md or ./AGENTS.md?'), c('Should skills/sprint/AGENTS.md gain a line?')]
print('kb article named *-agents.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a path to AGENTS.md:', r)
sys.exit(0 if r[0] == 'design' and r[1:] == ['agents-rule'] * 3 else 1)
